units.source_text: 从信辅记事儿开始，他就热爱着本所的街道

en.t: From the time Shinsuke first became aware of things, he loved the streets of Honjo.

units.source_text: ——一个连街道树木都没有的街道，常年尘土飞扬。

en.t: It was a town without even roadside trees, where dust swirled all year round.

units.source_text: 然而，让年幼的信辅了解到大自然的美丽的也还是本所的街町。

en.t: Yet it was still the town of Honjo that taught the young Shinsuke the beauty of nature.

units.source_text: 他就是在杂乱不堪的街道上，吃着粗点心长大的少年。

en.t: He was a boy who grew up eating coarse sweets amid those disorderly streets.

units.source_text: 其实，乡下——尤其是遍地稻田，在本所东边的乡下，对于他这种乡下长大的少年并没有吸引力。

en.t: In fact, the countryside, especially the countryside east of Honjo with rice fields everywhere, held no attraction for a boy like him who had grown up there.

units.source_text: 这是因为他抬眼所能看见的，与其说是自然之美，毋宁说是自然之丑。

en.t: That was because what he saw whenever he lifted his eyes was less the beauty of nature than its ugliness.

units.source_text: 虽然本所的街道没什么自然景色，但是那些长在屋顶上的野草，映在水坑蓝天白云，都呈现出一种让人心生怜爱的美丽。

en.t: Although the streets of Honjo had little natural scenery, the wild grasses growing on the roofs and the blue sky and white clouds reflected in puddles all showed a beauty that stirred tender affection.

units.source_text: 正是因为这些美丽，他不知不觉得爱上了大自然。

en.t: It was because of these beauties that he came, without realizing it, to love nature.

units.source_text: 但是，让他对大自然的美逐渐开拓眼界的，并不只是本所的街道，

en.t: But it was not only the streets of Honjo that gradually opened his eyes to the beauty of nature,

units.source_text: 还有书本上的内容——他小学的时候钟爱阅读过数次的德富芦花的《自然与人生》，

en.t: there were also things he found in books, such as Tokutomi Roka's Nature and Life, which he loved and read several times when he was in elementary school,

units.source_text: 还有拉波克《论自然之美》的翻译版本。这些都让他深受启发。

en.t: and a translated edition of Lubbock's work on the beauty of nature. All of these deeply inspired him.

units.source_text: 但是，对他认识自然影响最大的仍然是本所的街町。

en.t: Even so, what influenced his understanding of nature the most was still the town of Honjo.

units.source_text: 那个不管是房子也好，树木也好，亦或是那条道路，看起来都是十分寒酸的街町。

en.t: It was a shabby-looking town, whether one looked at its houses, its trees, or even that road.
